title: Leslie Lamport: Thinking Above the Code
summary: Leslie Lamport argues that programmers, like architects, should write rigorous specifications before coding, especially for concurrent and distributed systems. The talk introduces the case for writing specs (the TLA+ mindset) as a way of thinking above the code.
why: HN points people to it as Lamport's own case for thinking and writing a spec before coding, and as an entry point to TLA+.

quote.text: He's just saying that you should think before you code and that most specifications should be just a few sentences stating what you intend to do.
